title: Make the profile card safe to render
acceptanceCriteria: Markup in `bio` is shown as text: no element is created from it
A `"` in `name` or `avatarUrl` can't add an attribute to the avatar ``; `alt` and `src` hold the raw strings

`website` becomes a link only when it parses as an absolute `http:` or `https:` URL; anything else (any casing or padding of `javascript:`, even a tab inside the word, `data:`, `vbscript:`, or a bare `ann.dev`) is shown as plain text
A valid `http` or `https` website still links to that URL
